children: Canadian security solutions firm's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 14.4% yr/yr to C$10 mln
Adjusted EBITDA more than doubled yr/yr, driven by higher revenue and margin expansion
Company's NSSG unit launched AI-powered TESEUM platform after quarter end
Company aims to increase recurring revenues by scaling HALO deployments across new verticals
Avante plans to improve Adjusted EBITDA margins by focusing on higher-margin service lines and efficiency
Company intends to pursue M&A opportunities to expand in the security services industry
DIVISIONAL GROWTH - Protective Services revenue rose 16.7% and Electronic Security revenue increased 34.1%, driving overall Q1 growth
RECURRING REVENUE - Recurring Monthly Revenue grew 6.6% yr/yr, reflecting net growth in monitoring customers and new recurring services
HIGHER MARGIN SEGMENTS - Gross margin improved to 44.9% from 37.9% yr/yr, driven by growth in HALO and NSSG segments
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Avante Corp is C$2.75, about 61.8% above its August 27 closing price of C$1.70
